wacc.source: Assumption. CAPM check: EUR 10Y AAA yield 3.266% (ECB, 2026-11-05) + relevered beta ~0.465 (Damodaran Europe Oil/Gas Integrated cash-corrected unlevered beta 0.406, D/E 0.194, 25% tax) x France ERP 5.006% = ~5.6% cost of equity; cost of debt 5.18% pre-tax; weights 84/16 gives ~5.3% mechanical WACC. Raised to 7.0% for commodity-price and energy-transition risk and USD cash flows vs EUR risk-free rate.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 3.27% EUR risk-free rate and long-run nominal growth, reflecting mature, transitioning energy demand.

diluted_shares.source: Diluted weighted shares not reported in tool data (null). Approximation: attributable net income 13,127M / diluted EPS 5.78 (ESEF report) = ~2,271M shares; EPS may be after hybrid coupons so reviewer should verify against the filing.
